notes.title: Update 0.5.1 - Katanas and Other Melee Goodness
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a Katana melee weapon!
[*] Enemies can be hit much faster. - This buffs fast firing weapons but prevents non-piercing bullets from piercing anyway due to enemies having a lengthy "invincibility state" after being damaged
[*] Increased Shovel damage from 15 to 20
[*] Fixed Shovel knockback so it actually pushes zombies back much much further
[*] Increased Axe damage from 20 to 40
[*] The Ammo Cooler now alerts you when you are out of ammo
[*] Melee animation performance tweaks
[*] New effects on bullet collisions with enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40809991/1bf0973e1bb2c8a3e2ac59e43dbc8dd8f47d024d.png[/img]

[b]The Good Stuff:[/b]
Changed the term 'upgrades' into 'perks' for clarity
Perks now only cost 5 scrap and go up in price together
New perk: item damage
New loot box: scrap boxes
Added a bullet hit sound (I thought this was already added!)
New item: upgrade kits
Barricades have two levels of upgrades that boost their effectiveness
Bear traps have two levels of upgrades (fire traps followed by explosive traps)
Auto turrets are refilled from upgrade kits
Throwing axes drop scrap or another throwing axe on enemy hit. Perfect for resource management builds!
Changed the health "item" to an actual item: medkit
Added medkits to the starter loot box
Added explosive red barrels that spawn like loot boxes
Scrap shop price balancing
Barricades now affect Junebug's movement speed as well (does not cause damage to player though)
Added descriptions for items on the item wheel
Added visual improvements and changes on Junebug's Cabin level
VFX tweaks
Increased crossbow explosion damage

[b]Bugs:[/b]
Fixed turret low animation error
Fixed the revolver's attack speed (it's faster now)
Optimization (over thousands of thrice-duplicated foliage removed)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40809991/e020e7eb88e169709d5d24e679f510106729e5d2.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.2.2: New Items!
notes.notes:
Build a stronghold right there on the front lawn with the latest update! 

* Items are now split into offensive (throwables) and defensive
* New item: Pipe Bomb: Attracts enemies when thrown
* New item: Barricade: Slows and damages enemies on contact
* New item: Auto Turret: Automatically shoots enemies nearby
* Items can now be bought with scrap in the shop
* Crossbow bolts now explode, causing AOE damage
* Reworked the Moonshine Cocktail fire effect
* Balancing

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Three new ambient effects that change nightly, fireflies, rain, and wind. This is a precursor to having different types of waves each night.

Nerfed scrap drops from enemies, loot boxes, and totems.

Laundry Machine scene decoration blends better with the environment.

Randomized walk and run speeds of the zombies with larger min/max values to create more variation with groups.

Added Junebug's truck, for some reason.

Updated the map with more environmental objects/foliage.

Added a warning when the generator is close to being depleted.

Changed 'Start Game' to 'Endless Mode' to better reflect game mode and make room for a more classic game mode.

Added a little bloom effect.

Added a loot box icon to help you find them. :)

Added a restart button in the pause menu.

Beartraps now cause enemies to show a hurt effect when activated. 

Ghosts spawn more initially from enemies but less frequently from other Ghosts.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
* Pause menu should now always be on top of every UI asset
* Camera angle adjustments to show a bit more ahead of you. May be adjusted more and more in the future based on feedback.
* Generator should now make a sound when charging. [b]Note[/b]: currently working on fixing some sounds not being played as they should.
* Updated camera on the title screen to avoid ugly clipping issues.
* Enemies drop ammo even more frequently, now with a chance of dropping scrap, while also spawning ghosts a [i]little[/i] less often.
* Boosted one of the audio tracks.
* Skull Totems also drop scrap now, giving you more reason to destroy them.
* The larger zombies, ghouls, have a health nerf.

notes.notes:
